Command line tooling for Extrittio IoT Hub

Usage: extrittio [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  run           Run the complete single-node Extrittio Edge stack with embedded Turso
  serve         Run the Extrittio backend service
  migrate       Run pending database migrations and exit
  init          Initialize database seed data and service certificates, then exit
  database      Inspect and maintain an embedded Turso database
  auth          Authenticate and manage the local CLI session
  config        Show or update local CLI configuration
  health        Check backend liveness
  ready         Check backend readiness, including database reachability
  devices       Manage devices
  device-types  Manage device types
  fleets        Manage fleets
  firmware      Publish and list firmware artifacts
  ota           Deploy and inspect firmware over-the-air updates
  api-keys      Manage API keys for CI and automation
  certs         Download or regenerate device certificates
  provision     Create a device and emit client provisioning material
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --url <URL>        Extrittio backend URL for client and admin commands [env: EXTRITTIO_URL=]
      --token <TOKEN>    JWT token for client and admin commands. Defaults to EXTRITTIO_TOKEN or the saved CLI config [env: EXTRITTIO_TOKEN=]
      --config <CONFIG>  CLI config file path [env: EXTRITTIO_CLI_CONFIG=]
  -o, --output <OUTPUT>  Output format [default: table] [possible values: table, json]
  -h, --help             Print help
  -V, --version          Print version
